name: 黑白女仆装
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Primary request: A beautiful Japanese anime costume-design illustration sheet, CLOTHES ONLY, for a cute soft-pink-and-white themed character. Use the attached image ONLY as an illustration-style reference: its clean lively ink contours, flat soft cel-shaded color blocks, charming anime shapes and clear folds. DO NOT draw or reproduce its character, anatomy, hair, pose, face, skin or setting.
Art direction: hand-drawn 2D anime production costume design, visibly illustrated, cute light delicate shapes, bold readable garment silhouettes, slightly rounded hems, lively angular cel-shaded folds, only two tones per fabric, warm cream highlights and soft blush-pink or lilac shadow accents. Very simplified lace scallops and small ribbons. Matte shoes with one small drawn highlight. Fabrics shown as broad flat colored shapes, with tiny symbolic hatch marks only where needed. No rendered fabric texture, no realistic leather, no product photography, no 3D, no realistic lighting or realistic shadows, no grain, no noisy crosshatching. Prefer characterful anime fashion drawing over polished retail catalog realism.
Layout: landscape cream-white sheet with generous white space; a large EMPTY front and smaller back view of the main garment on the left, detached inner garments next to it, cute small accessory illustrations arranged neatly on the right, and small separate hosiery and underwear flat drawings along the bottom. Very few short handwritten Chinese labels, a small title and five round color swatches. No spreadsheet borders or stiff boxes, no technical product infographic, no long prose. Include actual clothes from the specification, not background props. Every garment is a flattened empty textile shape, not worn, not arranged around an invisible body. Hosiery is drawn as simple flattened folded/extended textile objects. Draw functional everyday underwear modestly as small flat textile drawings, not sculpted anatomical forms.
Absolutely NO character, NO human, NO face, NO hair, NO skin, NO anatomy, NO body outline, NO mannequin, NO ghost wearer, NO hands or feet inside items. Keep all clothing closed and empty. Do not reproduce cats or cat ears as body parts; optional cat-ear headband is a detached costume prop only. Never put any human thumbnail or portrait on the sheet, bag, label or charm. Preserve the stated outfit colors and construction while simplifying the rendering into anime artwork.

Small title: "黑白女仆装"
Set 01 / 09.
Garment specification:
top: 黑色连衣裙上身，方领，短泡泡袖，领口和袖口各滚一圈细白蕾丝；前襟一排小小的银色圆扣，最上面那颗磨得比别的亮
bottom: 同一条裙子的裙摆，及膝，内衬一层薄纱把弧度撑起来；转身时裙摆会慢半拍
legs: 奶白色 80D 哑光连裤袜，平纹、不带提花，腰口是宽软边，脚尖同色加固；外面叠一双白色棉质短袜，袜口翻折出一道窄窄的扇形蕾丝边，刚好露在鞋带上方
feet: 黑色圆头单鞋，低跟，脚背一根横带扣着一枚小银搭扣；站一晚上不废脚
accessories: 白色围裙，肩带和下摆缀荷叶边，腰后系一个大蝴蝶结；白色蕾丝发箍；胸前别一枚小小的银色咖啡杯胸针；围裙口袋里插着点单本和一支笔
underwear: 奶白色棉质无钢圈文胸，平整薄杯、可调节肩带，领边一圈细包边，中央缝一枚同色小布蝴蝶结；同色中腰全包棉质内裤，腰口和裤口都用柔软包边；裙内另穿白色棉弹平脚安全裤，裤脚平整，不缀荷叶边
optional: 猫耳发箍——只在店里活动日或要拍宣传照时戴，不是每天

name: 浅樱粉短开衫配藏青细格百褶裙
filename: ../redesign-v5/06_浅樱粉短开衫配藏青细格百褶裙_anime-v5.png
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Japanese anime CLOTHES-ONLY costume design sheet, outfit 06 of 09.
Primary request: A stylish sweet Japanese PREPPY feminine outfit, grounded in collared blouse + short pink cardigan + high-waisted navy plaid pleated skirt + Mary Jane shoes. The character's established fashion is sweet and academic. Achieve fashion through the cropped-over-high-waist proportion, slightly relaxed cardigan sleeves, clear wide skirt pleats, very fine plaid, soft pink against navy, and tasteful tiny silver details. Clothing is for an autumn city outing. Keep it pretty, softly youthful and refined.
Reference image role: Japanese 2D anime drawing style ONLY. Do not copy the person, body, hairstyle, school uniform, pose or background.
Visual style: warm fine brown-gray hand-drawn contours, beautiful restrained cel-shaded pastel colors, simple crisp illustrated folds, matte textiles as clean color blocks, elegant anime artbook reference sheet. Never photographic or 3D. No hyperreal woven fabric, glossy product renders, or dramatic lighting.
Composition: landscape warm-white sheet with ample negative space. Left: empty cardigan layered over empty blouse, and empty skirt separately underneath with a VISIBLE gap. Center: cardigan front and back, blouse, and skirt front/back, all detached empty garments. Right: empty shoes, crossbody bag, small silver clips. Bottom: folded EMPTY tights and small flat everyday underwear textile drawings. Include five small color swatches and only short handwritten Chinese item labels. No long text paragraphs, tables or rigid borders.
The source of sweetness: light pink cardigan, small blouse collar, thin understated black ribbon tie, navy pleats and brown double-strap Mary Janes. The ribbon is small, NOT a large decorative bow. The skirt is finely plaid, not loud tartan. Avoid childish costume details: no cape, pinafore, bib, flowers, star motifs, animal bags, ruffles, scallops, heavy lace, giant bows or heart doodles. Avoid edgy/urban nightlife styling: no biker jacket, leather jacket, asymmetric skirt, boots, choker, studs, chains, metallic hardware dominating the design, all-black outfit or handbag in burgundy. Avoid tweed matching suits and pearl necklaces.
STRICT NO WEARER: no human, no head, no face, no hair, no skin, no anatomy, no body outline, no mannequin, no ghost model, NO LEGS even in tights, NO FEET inside shoes. Do not connect tights or shoes below the skirt. Tights must be folded flat as textile objects. Clothing only, all items empty and spatially separate. Underwear shown as small neutral flat product drawings. No character portrait anywhere.
Exact title: "浅樱粉短开衫配藏青细格百褶裙"
Small number: 06 / 09
Garment specification:
top: 浅樱粉色短款 V 领针织开衫，纯色细针织，长度刚到高腰裙腰头，肩线略落，袖身稍宽，袖口和下摆收窄罗纹；前襟四颗小小的同色包扣，敞开穿；里面是奶白色长袖衬衫，小尖领，领下系细黑丝带，结很小、两端自然垂下，袖口从开衫里露出一道奶白边
bottom: 藏青色高腰细格纹百褶短裙，裙长在膝上约十厘米，腰头平整，腰下留一小段不展开的褶线，再散成利落的宽褶；格纹由极细的浅灰线和淡粉线交织，远看接近纯藏青，侧面隐藏拉链，裙摆不缀花边
legs: 烟灰色 60D 哑光连裤袜，袜筒是很细的同色竖纹，脚背和脚尖改成平纹，宽软腰口、同色加固脚尖；单穿这一双，不叠短袜
feet: 深巧克力棕色玛丽珍鞋，圆杏形鞋头，脚背两根窄横带各配一枚小银搭扣；三厘米低方跟，鞋底只略加厚，皮面柔和微亮，鞋面不加蝴蝶结
accessories: 米白色小号翻盖斜挎包，深棕色细皮肩带和窄窄包边，包盖中央一枚小银搭扣；小号素银圆耳夹和细发夹；黑色丝带只用在领结或发尾，不另戴项链
underwear: 奶白色棉质无钢圈文胸，平整薄杯，可调节肩带，边缘压一道浅樱粉细包边，中央一枚小小的同色布结；同色中腰全包棉质内裤，纯色，腰口包布松紧，两侧压浅樱粉细线；裙内穿藏青色棉弹平脚安全裤，平整裤口
